name: Flexible bonding strap
summary: A flexible braid or strap bonding a movable or vibrating metal part, such as a panel door, to the earthing system.
description: A bonding strap connects metal parts that cannot be bonded with rigid conductors, such as hinged doors carrying equipment, gland plates, cable tray across expansion joints and equipment on anti-vibration mounts. Braided straps also provide low impedance at high frequency, which helps with EMC bonding in drive panels.

The symbol does not state cross-sectional area or length, both of which affect protective and high-frequency performance. A long thin strap may satisfy continuity tests but give poor EMC performance. Painted surfaces under strap lugs must be cleaned for a reliable connection.
readingNotes: Check strap size against the protective conductor rule.
Look for EMC bonding requirements in drive panels.
distinction: A bonding strap is a flexible protective or EMC bond; a flexible conductor is a circuit conductor that must flex in service.
